g.text: +3V3_MCU = +3V3D via D6 OR UPDI pin 1 via D5 (ATtiny only).

g.desc: +3V3_MCU = +3V3D via D6 OR UPDI pin 1 via D5 (ATtiny only).

g.text: ATtiny3226 @ 8 MHz internal, 3.3 V. Optiboot over CP2102N; DTR auto-reset on PB4 (RSTPINCFG=0x3, megaTinyCore "UPDI w/reset on PB4"), as EtherKeyerMini C3/R4.

g.desc: ATtiny3226 @ 8 MHz internal, 3.3 V. Optiboot over CP2102N; DTR auto-reset on PB4 (RSTPINCFG=0x3, megaTinyCore "UPDI w/reset on PB4"), as EtherKeyerMini C3/R4.

g.text: EKM JP2/JP3 omitted per Jason). Pin 1 VCC (via D5, feeds +3V3_MCU only), 2 TXD, 3 RXD/UPDI, 4 GND.
